ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels exceeding 80% of the visible ventral surface, contrasted with low-intensity (black) pixels restricted to the trailing edges and peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white macro-blob covering the central field of both lobes; irregular black peripheral banding along the trailing edge; a high-contrast black focal patch at the axial base where the fluke meets the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a clear apex dividing the two lobes; internal angle approximately 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations with high frequency and variable pixel-amplitude (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the lateral margins of both lobes, tapering towards rounded, slightly upturned tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of small, circular, textured bumps and dark focal points scattered across the white surface, particularly on the vertical lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of 3-4 distinct, short, dark linear pixel disruptions oriented diagonally on the upper portion of the vertical lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor irregular notches and asymmetric indentations along the trailing edge of the left lobe that break the standard serration frequency.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast, jagged 'sawtooth' boundary interface between the black peduncle base and the white fluke surface.
